title: 第12章：队里出现了叛徒！
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

或许是某人在给我们一些“警示”。

时间过得很快，一转眼到了第二天早上。

林昊悠闲的下了车，理由是熟悉环境。

晨雾里的青山镇很安静，镇民们已经开始了一天的工作，扛着工具，推着小车，沉默地从他身边走过，没人多看他一眼。

林昊启动了物资探测。

面板上的地图闪烁了几下，信号受到严重干扰，人类聚居区的复杂电磁环境让系统扫描变得困难。

但地图中央，一栋独立的小楼底下，一个深红色的高密度光团顽固地亮着。

【目标区域：赵永年住所】

【检测到大量物资信号，密度远超公共仓库】

林昊关掉面板，不动声色地拐进一条小巷。

巷子尽头，一个老大爷正蹲在地上修理一个破旧的扁担。

“大爷，问个事。”林昊递过去一支烟。

老大爷警惕地抬头，看了看周围，没接烟，压着嗓子飞快地说：“新来的？”

林昊点头。

“在这儿，想吃饭就得干活。一天挣够十个工分，食堂才给饭。”

老大爷的嘴皮子没怎么动，声音像从牙缝里挤出来，

“不干活，扣工分。扣完三天，就得去‘外围劳动’。”

“外围劳动？”

“就是赶出去。”老大爷的眼神黯淡下去，“外面全是丧尸，谁回得来？”

他顿了顿，又补充一句：“你们有车，有东西，当心点。

规矩是新来的得上交七成物资，车和武器，一根毛都不能留。”

老大爷的确是个明白人。

赵永年用恐惧和饥饿，在这里建立了一个属于他自己的帝国！

林昊谢过老大爷，继续往前走。

镇子北边，一排房子被单独隔了出来，门口有两个民兵站岗。

林昊路过时，看到一个戴着眼镜、头发花白的老人正在院子里摆弄几盆枯死的植物。

老人看到林昊，眼神亮了一下，但很快又被看守的民兵用眼神警告了回去。

张教授，原生物工程学教授。

Page (1/3)

Maybe someone is giving us some "warnings".

Time passed quickly, and it was the next morning in a blink of an eye.

Lin Hao got out of the car leisurely, because he was familiar with the environment.

Qingshan Town was very quiet in the morning mist. The townspeople had already started their day's work. Carrying tools and pushing carts, they walked past him in silence. No one glanced at him.

Lin Hao started the material detection.

The map on the panel flashed several times, the signal was seriously interfered with, and the complex electromagnetic environment in human settlements made system scanning difficult.

But in the center of the map, under a small independent building, a dark red high-density light group stubbornly lit up.

[Target area: Zhao Yongnian’s residence]

[A large number of material signals were detected, the density far exceeds that of public warehouses]

Lin Hao turned off the panel and turned into an alley quietly.

At the end of the alley, an old man was squatting on the ground repairing an old pole.

"Uncle, I have a question." Lin Hao handed over a cigarette.

The old man raised his head warily, looked around, did not pick up the cigarette, and said quickly in a low voice: "New here?"

Lin Hao nodded.

"Here, if you want to eat, you have to work. If you earn ten work points a day, you will be given food in the cafeteria."

The old man didn't move his lips very much, and his voice seemed to be squeezed out from between his teeth.

"If you don't work, your work points will be deducted. After three days of deduction, you have to go to 'peripheral labor'."

"Peripheral labor?"

"Just drive them out." The old man's eyes dimmed, "There are zombies outside, who can come back?"

He paused and then added: "You have cars and things, so be careful.

The rule is that newcomers must hand over 70% of their supplies, cars and weapons, and not a hair can be left behind."

The old man is indeed a sensible person.

Zhao Yongnian used fear and hunger to build an empire of his own here!

Lin Hao thanked the old man and continued walking forward.

On the north side of the town, a row of houses was separated, and two militiamen stood guard at the door.

When Lin Hao passed by, he saw an old man with glasses and gray hair playing with several pots of dead plants in the yard.

When the old man saw Lin Hao, his eyes lit up, but he was quickly warned back by the guarding militiamen.

Professor Zhang, former professor of bioengineering.
